notes: Fixed in 2.78: EDC16 fault-code clear — solved from the ECU firmware itself. The clear handler takes a 2-byte group id (FF 00, the same group the fault read uses), not the generic all-groups form. Clear now sends 14 FF 00 first in the normal session; no session switching or unlock needed on this ECU. Earlier forms and the session ladder remain as fallbacks for other ECUs.
